component.name: Matters
component.summary: Plan what matters, when it matters

description.p: Matters is a keyboard-driven personal task manager built around Getting Things Done. It keeps a clear hierarchy of areas, projects, headings, tasks and checklists, and separates when a task starts asking for attention from its hard deadline.

ul.li: Inbox, Today, This Evening, Upcoming, Anytime, Someday and the Logbook
Notes, tags and checklists that open in place
Reminders as desktop notifications, and tasks that repeat on a schedule or after completion
Every operation reachable from the keyboard
Your tasks stay on your computer, in a local database
